text: This report recommends amending the Construction Agreement for Request For Quotation 43 - Tiger Boardwalk and Habitat Project to complete additional work.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Director, Project Management, or designate, to negotiate and amend the Construction Agreement for Request For Quotation 43 - Tiger Boardwalk and Habitat Project up to the amount of $5,521,708.18, excluding applicable taxes.
